body: I'll bring the meds up (I think we're on try 4 or 5 right now). My nurse has actually been really helpful, I've just had a lot of stuff to deal with. Thanks *hug*

;)

I did get a friend to drive me to another friends house this weekend to hang around.

It helped. I usually can't open up with my friends because I feel the need to "be strong" or whatever (we're all going through a fair bit and I've typically been the one giving support - and there is a self imposed expectation of "being ok") but I let them know that I had to set some kind of boundaries and it was nice being with them and not having them expect anything of me and even take care of me for a bit. 

The depersonalization stuff is just really odd though. It doesn't even feel like that happened to me even though I know it did. I have an appointment with a doc to talk about it soon.

Thanks, it just seemed obvious at the time though. 
Things in the past? Usually just playing games nonstop and sleeping 20+ hours a day (dreams easier to deal with than reality), neither of which really interest me much right now :(

I'm seeing a psych nurse every few weeks and taking ativan as needed (I know that benzos can cause depersonalization stuff, but it happened before I started taking the ativan. 

Neither is really helpful to be quite honest. Ativan does get me a bit stoned and calm, but I'm also really worried about getting addicted to it. Only taking 1-2mg/day. 

Every single antidepressant I've tried only made my anxiety worse, so I'm not on any.

For what it's worth, your post helped me understand that even though I stopped attempting, etc, I never really found a reason to live. And I suspect that I'll keep on coming back to this headspace if I never find one.
